metadata.title: Light Galangal Tea | Brew
metadata.description:
In this third session of brew, I am going to brew using a medicinal plant known as Light Galangal or shell ginger. The plant goes by the scientific name Alpinia Officinarum. 
There are ongoing researches on its effects on human longevity as statistically, Okinawan natives who include the light galangal in their diet have very ling life expectancy. It is sold in lot of Asian countries for making herbal tea and for flavouring food. 

Thank you for watching.
